attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 with the specified ed25519 public key as its sole authorized_keys entry, locked the account password, and added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/10-key-only.conf enforcing PubkeyAuthentication yes / PasswordAuthentication no / KbdInteractiveAuthentication no / AuthenticationMethods publickey. Verified with live SSH tests (matching key succeeds, password/non-matching key rejected) both before and after a full node restart, confirming persistence via a changed boot_id.
